subject: Important Update: Changes to Our Payment Process
body: Dear valued customers, We wanted to inform you of some changes to our payment process. Starting next month, we will be transitioning to a new payment platform to better serve your needs. This transition will not affect your current subscriptions or services, but you may notice a different interface when making payments. We appreciate your understanding during this process and are here to assist with any questions or concerns you may have. Thank you for your continued support.
